quickAnswer: The Screenshot Secret Redactor & Sensitive Data Scanner inspects pasted images and code snippets for exposed secrets (OpenAI keys, AWS credentials, GitHub tokens, private key headers, and payment numbers). Users can draw custom blackout, blur, or pixelation masks directly on an interactive canvas and copy the sanitized image with one click. Tool inputs are processed locally on your device in browser memory with no server uploads.

howTo.name: Paste Screenshot from Clipboard
howTo.text: Press Ctrl+V (or Cmd+V on macOS) to paste a screenshot directly, or drag and drop an image file into the workspace.

howTo.name: Select Redaction Tool
howTo.text: Choose your preferred redaction style: Solid Blackout Box, Gaussian Blur, or Pixelation Mask.

howTo.name: Draw Redaction Bounding Boxes
howTo.text: Click and drag across any credentials, email addresses, or proprietary tokens visible in the screenshot.

howTo.name: Copy or Download Sanitized Image
howTo.text: Click Copy to Clipboard to immediately paste the redacted screenshot into Slack, Discord, or GitHub issues.

faq.q: Are my pasted images or credentials sent to any server?
faq.a: No. All image loading, canvas drawing, pixel filtering, and redaction masking execute entirely within local browser RAM. Tool inputs are processed locally on your device, ensuring zero third-party exposure of sensitive tokens.

faq.q: Why is simple black highlighter sometimes dangerous for redacting text?
faq.a: Many basic mobile and PDF editors apply semi-transparent black highlighter strokes (e.g., 90% opacity). While text appears obscured to human eyes, brightness and contrast adjustments can recover the underlying text. ToolkitGen draws solid, opaque 100% alpha blackout rectangles directly into the canvas raster, completely replacing the underlying pixels.

faq.q: Which secret token formats are automatically recognized?
faq.a: The scanner identifies OpenAI project keys (sk-proj-...), Anthropic API keys (sk-ant-...), AWS Access Key IDs (AKIA...), GitHub Personal Access Tokens (ghp_...), Google Cloud API keys (AIza...), Slack webhook tokens, private key headers, and Luhn-validated credit card numbers.

faq.q: Can I copy the redacted screenshot directly into Slack or Discord without saving a file?
faq.a: Yes. The Copy Redacted Image button utilizes the modern asynchronous Clipboard API (navigator.clipboard.write) to place a clean PNG image blob directly into your system clipboard.

articleHtml:
Screenshot Credential Leakage: Threat Vectors and Redaction Standards

Screen captures shared across team Slack channels, public GitHub issue trackers, and customer support tickets represent a leading vector for corporate secret compromise. Understanding irreversible redaction prevents accidental credential disclosure.

The Flaws of Superficial Redaction

Developers frequently rely on quick desktop drawing tools that introduce fatal security flaws:

  • Semi-Transparent Highlighter Tools: Many native markup utilities utilize translucent highlighter strokes with an alpha value between $0.80$ and $0.90$. While text appears obscured on a standard sRGB monitor, pulling the image into an editor and adjusting curves, exposure, or high-pass filters instantly reveals the original characters.
  • Light Swirl and Mosaic Distortions: Algorithmic swirl and light mosaic filters retain local mathematical pixel variance. Machine learning models can invert mosaic blocks and reconstruct text with high accuracy.
  • PDF Layer Obfuscation: Placing an opaque shape object over a text block in a vector PDF leaves the underlying ASCII text layer intact, allowing anyone to select, copy, or grep the underlying secret.

Irreversible Raster Redaction Standards

ToolkitGen implements true destructive raster masking directly on the HTML5 2D Canvas buffer:

$$\forall (x, y) \in \text{Bounding Box}, \quad \text{RGBA}(x, y) = (0, 0, 0, 255)$$

The underlying pixel memory values are completely overwritten with pure black ($0x000000FF$) before any image blob is exported. No cryptographic inversion or mathematical reconstruction can recover data that has been physically replaced in memory.

High-Risk Credential Formats to Monitor

Modern cloud providers and AI API vendors utilize structured token prefixes designed for automated detection:

  • OpenAI Project Keys: Begin with the strict prefix sk-proj- followed by 48+ alphanumeric characters.
  • AWS Access Keys: Begin with AKIA (standard user) or ASIA (temporary STS credential) followed by 16 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
  • GitHub Personal Access Tokens: Standardized with ghp_ for classic personal access tokens and github_pat_ for fine-grained tokens.
Security Notice: All image processing and secret pattern scanning occurs locally in browser memory. Inputs are not uploaded to our servers. ToolkitGen is an independent platform.
